item: Read seam: queries.py reads through KeywordMentionRead
summary: The largest reader of the keyword rows (134 references, read-only) now goes through the read-only KeywordMentionRead model over the keyword_mentions_all view instead of the write model; behaviour-neutral (458 related tests pass), conjunction.py (which imported the model through queries.py) moves with it, and the seam ratchet's two entries are removed. The Opus review found that init_db's stamp alignment runs alembic, whose env.py drops the view, AFTER the ensure: the first boot of an install with a lagging stamp left every migrated reader on 'no such table' until a restart; init_db now ensures the view again after the alignment (regression test boots twice).
